_meta.description: Heart event #4 for npc_kaydee: The Past

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Jack. Sit. I need to tell you something.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I wasn't always this... put together. Shocking, I know.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I came from a rougher town. East of here. Near the Scorchlands.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I learned to be sharp because soft got you hurt.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Someone I trusted... used my softness against me.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: So I stopped being soft. Built the Gear. Built the attitude.

options.text: I'm sorry that happened to you.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Don't pity me. I don't do pity. I do strength.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: But... thank you. For listening without trying to fix it.
